# Vestra Player plugin SDK 1.5.4 (@vestra-player/sdk) — reference for the AI

Made by Vestra Player AI from the SDK's README and .d.ts files (tests/vendor-sdk.mjs) until the SDK ships its own llms.txt.
{SDK} is the read-only SDK folder named in the system prompt; paths below are relative to it.

## Files

- {SDK}/README.md — overview, quick start, command line
- {SDK}/dist/plugin/types.d.ts — the whole plugin API with TSDoc and examples (search it with grep, read line ranges)
- {SDK}/dist/plugin/testing.d.ts — the test host for tests/*.test.ts: startPlugin, TestHost
- {SDK}/slint/vestra/*.slint, {SDK}/slint/palette.slint — the player's Slint library (`@vestra/theme.slint`, `@vestra/widgets.slint`, …)
- llms-full.txt (next to this file) — this index, the README and the source of the eight examples

## Examples (full source in llms-full.txt)

- hello — one menu command and an on-screen message
- blur — a tool window with one slider that blurs the video
- signal-generator — generated video and audio frames
- bookmark — a tool window bound to the playback state
- panel-menu — a sidebar panel with its own right-click menu
- menus — radio items, separator groups, a changing title
- theme-widgets — a tool window drawn with the player's theme and widgets
- markdown — a window that shows a Markdown document

## The plugin object: modules and the capability each needs

`activate(plugin)` receives a Plugin (a Scope). Each module below documents its manifest capability in parentheses.

- plugin.commands — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:140 — Menu commands and their default bindings (`commands`).
- plugin.windows — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:142 — Tool windows from `.slint` files (`ui.window`).
- plugin.panels — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:144 — Docked panels: bottom bar, sidebar and backdrop (`ui.mount`).
- plugin.dialogs — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:146 — Native file dialogs and confirmation alerts (`ui.dialog`).
- plugin.player — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:148 — Playback state and controls (`playback.read`, `events`, `playback.control`).
- plugin.video — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:155 — Video processing: this plugin's filter chain, the display layer and the GPU render options.
- plugin.audio — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:181 — Audio processing: this plugin's filter chain and delay (`processing.audio`, `playback.read` and `events`, as for VideoFilter).
- plugin.subtitles — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:192 — Subtitle tracks, uploads and style (`subtitles.read`, `subtitles.control`).
- plugin.media — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:194 — Frozen snapshots and offline exports (`media.read`, `media.control`).
- plugin.resolvers — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:196 — Page-URL to stream-URL resolvers (`source.resolve`).
- plugin.packages — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:198 — The installed plugins; validation, trials, installs (`plugins.manage` for changes).
- plugin.osd — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:200 — On-screen messages over the video (`ui.osd`).
- plugin.host — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:202 — The player's own core playback actions (`commands`).
- plugin.clipboard — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:204 — The system clipboard (`clipboard`).
- plugin.power — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:206 — Keeping the computer awake while playing (`playback.control`).
- plugin.tools — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:208 — ffmpeg / ffprobe, run by this plugin's process.
- plugin.storage — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:210 — JSON settings files in `dataDirectory`.
- plugin.system — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:212 — Show files in the file manager, open files and links.
- plugin.secrets — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:214 — Small secrets in the system's secret store (`secrets`).
- plugin.window — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:216 — The main window: fullscreen, video area, size, level, pointer hiding.
- plugin.app — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:218 — The player's version and components, and the system it runs on.
- plugin.bindings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:220 — Every command's bindings and the user's overrides (`bindings.manage`).
- plugin.ui — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:222 — Runtime images for Slint `image` properties.
- plugin.timeline — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:224 — Marks on the seek bar, merged from every plugin's layer.
- plugin.drops — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:226 — Files dropped on the video area, by extension (`ui.drop`).
- plugin.appearance — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:228 — The player's palette.
- plugin.settings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:230 — Pages in the player's options window (`ui.settings`).
- plugin.scope — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:235 — A child scope; disposing it releases only what was created through it.
- plugin.add — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:243 — Adopt an existing handle: it is disposed together with this scope.
- plugin.onDispose — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:257 — Run `cleanup` when this scope is disposed (for example `clearInterval` or closing a socket).
- plugin.onError — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:274 — Errors thrown by handlers that the SDK invoked (command `run`, window and panel callbacks, `onChange` listeners) in this scope.
- plugin.update — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:283 — Re-evaluate every bound value (`bind()` functions and command state functions) and send what changed.
- plugin.id — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:319 — The manifest id, e.g.
- plugin.dataDirectory — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:333 — A writable directory for this plugin's own files (settings, remembered folders).

## Capabilities (manifest `capabilities`, apiVersion `vestra/1`)

`producer.av`, `playback.read`, `playback.control`, `source.resolve`, `events`, `commands`, `ui.window`, `ui.mount`, `ui.dialog`, `plugins.manage`, `processing.video`, `processing.audio`, `subtitles.read`, `subtitles.control`, `media.read`, `media.control`, `ui.osd`, `clipboard`, `window.control`, `bindings.manage`, `timeline.marks`, `ui.drop`, `ui.settings`, `ui.theme`, `secrets`

# README.md

## Features

- **One typed API** (`vestra/1`) for commands and menus, windows, panels, settings pages, on-screen messages, playback state and control, video and audio filters, and generated streams.
- **Native user interfaces** written in [Slint](https://slint.dev), with the player's own theme and widgets.
- **Tests without the player**: `@vestra-player/sdk/testing` runs your plugin against an in-memory host with `node --test`.
- **One command line tool**, `vestra-plugin`, to check, test, build and pack a `.vxp` package.
- **The same API on macOS and Windows**; every plugin runs in its own Node.js 26 process that the player ships.

## Install

```sh
npm i -D @vestra-player/sdk   # Node.js 26 or newer
```

## Quick start

`manifest.json` and `main.ts`:

```json
{
  "id": "examples.hello",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "apiVersion": "vestra/1",
  "entry": "main.ts",
  "capabilities": ["commands", "ui.osd"]
}
```

```ts
import type { Plugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "hello",
    path: ["Tools", "Hello"],
    run: () => plugin.osd.show("Hello"),
  });
}
```

Run `npx vestra-plugin pack` to check and package it, or start the player with `--plugin <folder>` to try it right away. This is [`examples/hello`](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/hello); [Getting started](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Getting_started.html) adds a window, tests and packaging.

## Examples

Complete, tested plugins in [`examples/`](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples). The [examples page](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Examples.html) shows each one with a screenshot and a step-by-step walkthrough.

| Example                                                                                                | What you learn                                                           | Walkthrough                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [hello](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/hello)                       | The smallest plugin: a manifest, one menu command, an on-screen message. | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Hello.html)                     |
| [blur](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/blur)                         | A video filter driven by one slider in a tool window.                    | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Blur.html)             |
| [signal-generator](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/signal-generator) | Generating video and audio frames yourself: colour bars and a sine tone. | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Signal_generator.html) |
| [bookmark](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/bookmark)                 | A tool window bound to the playback state, with Mark and Jump buttons.   | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Bookmark.html)         |
| [panel-menu](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/panel-menu)             | A sidebar panel with its own right-click menu.                           | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Panel_menu.html)       |
| [menus](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/menus)                       | Radio items, separator groups and a menu item whose title changes.       | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Menus.html)            |
| [theme-widgets](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/theme-widgets)       | A tool window drawn with the player's theme and widgets.                 | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Theme_widgets.html)    |
| [markdown](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples/markdown)                 | A window that shows a Markdown document.                                 | [Step by step](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Markdown.html)         |

## Command line

| Command                                                     | Does                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `vestra-plugin check [dir...]`                              | Checks the manifest, then a strict type check of the plugin and its tests. |
| `vestra-plugin test [dir...]`                               | Runs `node --test` on `tests/*.test.{ts,mjs}`.                             |
| `vestra-plugin build [dir...] [--version x.y.z]`            | Writes `dist/`: types stripped, files copied, manifest versioned.          |
| `vestra-plugin pack [dir...] [--version x.y.z] [--out dir]` | Builds, then packs `dist/` as `<id>-<version>.vxp`.                        |

## Compatibility

| SDK | Plugin API | Vestra Player                                                                             | Node.js                      |
| --- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| 1.0 | `vestra/1` | 0.1 or newer                                                                              | 22.18 or newer               |
| 1.1 | `vestra/1` | 0.2 or newer for the 1.1 additions                                                        | 22.18 or newer               |
| 1.2 | `vestra/1` | 0.2 or newer                                                                              | 26 (shipped with the player) |
| 1.3 | `vestra/1` | 0.2 or newer; 0.3 for the 1.3 additions (menu ids, `Theme.danger`, empty video chains)    | 26 (shipped with the player) |
| 1.4 | `vestra/1` | 0.2 or newer; 0.3 for the 1.3 additions. `ThemeId` is `"vestra"` only (see the CHANGELOG) | 26 (shipped with the player) |
| 1.5 | `vestra/1` | 0.2 or newer; 0.3 for the 1.3 additions; 0.4 for the 1.5 additions (`vestra-light`, `@vestra/icons.slint`) | 26 (shipped with the player) |

Minor releases only add backwards-compatible API; a breaking change gets a new `apiVersion` and a new major version. `@vestra-player/sdk/runtime` is for the player only and not covered by semver.

# Examples (vestra-player-sdk v1.5.4, examples/)

In your own project the dependency is "@vestra-player/sdk": "^1.5.4" instead of "file:../..".

## examples/hello

### examples/hello/README.md

````markdown
# Hello

The [Quick start](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk#quick-start), runnable: one menu command, **Tools → Hello**, that shows an on-screen message.

![Hello running in Vestra Player](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |
| --- | --- |
````

````markdown
# Blur

A live Gaussian blur over the video that is playing. **Video ▸ Blur…** opens a small window with one slider: move it to blur the video, set it to 0 to turn the blur off.

![The Blur window over a playing video](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities                                                           | API                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `commands`, `ui.window`, `processing.video`, `playback.read`, `events` | `commands.add` in the `@video` menu, `windows.create` with `bind` and `on`, `video.filter` with a `gblur` node; tests with `startPlugin` |

## Files

```text

ui/blur.slint       the window: one slider
tests/blur.test.ts  tests against the SDK's in-memory test host
```

## Run it

```

````

### examples/blur/main.ts

````ts
/**
 * Blur: Video ▸ Blur… opens a window with one slider that blurs the video.
 * Walkthrough: docs/examples/blur.md.
 */
// #region activate
import type { Plugin, VideoNode } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

export default function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  // #endregion activate
  // #region filter
  // This plugin's video filter chain; nothing is sent until set().
  const blur = plugin.video.filter("blur");
  let strength = 0; // the Gaussian sigma, 0–10; 0 means off

  function setStrength(value: number) {
    strength = Math.round(value * 10) / 10; // one decimal, like the label
    const chain: VideoNode[] =
      strength === 0 ? [] : [{ kind: "gblur", sigma: strength, steps: 3 }];
    blur.set(chain);
  }
  // #endregion filter

  // #region window
  const window = plugin.windows.create("ui/blur.slint");
  window.bind(() => ({
    strength,
    // Empty unless the player refused the blur.
    problem: blur.status.state === "failed" ? blur.status.error.message : "",
  }));
  window.on("strengthChanged", setStrength);
  // #endregion window

  // #region command
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "blur",
    path: ["@video", "Blur…"], // the player's Video menu, in any language
    run: () => window.show(),
  });
  // #endregion command
}
````

### examples/blur/tests/blur.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin, TestHost } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate from "../main.ts";

/** Start the plugin with a video already playing. */
async function start() {
  const host = new TestHost();
  host.setSource({ phase: "ready", duration: 60 });
  return startPlugin(activate, {
    directory: new URL("..", import.meta.url), // reads manifest.json
    host,
  });
}

/** The video chain the player holds for this plugin (`[]` when there is none). */
function chain(host: TestHost) {
  const [resource] = host.processing.resources.values();
  return resource?.nodes ?? [];
}

test("Video ▸ Blur… opens the window; the slider blurs the video", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await start();
  const command = host.command("blur");
  assert.deepEqual("path" in command.declaration && command.declaration.path, [
    "@video",
    "Blur…",
  ]);
  await command.run();
  const window = host.window("blur");
  assert.equal(window.visible, true);

  window.emit("strength-changed", 4);
  await host.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(chain(host), [{ kind: "gblur", sigma: 4, steps: 3 }]);
  assert.equal(window.props["problem"], "");
  await stop();
});

test("strength 0 removes the blur", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await start();
  await host.command("blur").run();
  const window = host.window("blur");
  window.emit("strength-changed", 6.5);
  await host.settle();
  window.emit("strength-changed", 0.02); // rounds to 0
  await host.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(chain(host), []);
  assert.equal(host.processing.resources.size, 0);
  await stop();
});

test("stopping the plugin withdraws the blur", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await start();
  await host.command("blur").run();
  host.window("blur").emit("strength-changed", 3);
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(host.processing.resources.size, 1);
  await stop();
  assert.equal(host.processing.resources.size, 0);
});
````

````slint
export component BlurWindow inherits Window {
    title: "Blur";
    width: 280px;
    background: Theme.bg-panel;

    in-out property <float> strength;
    in property <string> problem;
    callback strength-changed(float);

    VerticalLayout {
        padding: Theme.dialog-padding;
        spacing: 8px;
        HorizontalLayout {
            spacing: 8px;
            Slider {
                minimum: 0;
                maximum: 10;
                value <=> root.strength;
                changed(value) => { root.strength-changed(value); }
            }
            Text {
                width: 24px;
                text: round(root.strength * 10) / 10;
                color: Theme.text;
                font-size: Theme.font-body;
                horizontal-alignment: right;
            }
        }

            color: Theme.danger;
            font-size: Theme.font-body;

        }
    }
````

## examples/signal-generator

### examples/signal-generator/README.md

````markdown
# Signal Generator

A plugin that generates its own video and audio: **Open ▸ Signal generator** plays colour bars with a 1 kHz sine tone, and choosing it again stops them.

![Colour bars from the signal generator](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |
| --- | --- |
| `commands`, `producer.av`, `playback.control`, `playback.read` | `player.openStream` with a `frame()` callback, `Stream.stop` and `onStop`, a checkable command in the `@open` menu; tests with `startPlugin` |

```

Walkthrough: [Example: Signal generator](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Signal_generator.html).
````

### examples/signal-generator/main.ts

````ts
/**
 * Signal generator: Open ▸ Signal generator plays colour bars and a 1 kHz
 * sine tone that this plugin generates; choosing it again stops them.
 * Walkthrough: docs/examples/signal-generator.md.
 */
// #region format
import type { Plugin, Stream, StreamFrame } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

export const WIDTH = 640;
export const HEIGHT = 360;
/** 29.97 fps, the NTSC frame rate: 48000 / FPS is not a whole number. */
export const FPS = 30000 / 1001;
/** Every stream's audio is 48 kHz stereo, 32-bit float. */
const SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;
const FREQUENCY = 1000; // Hz
const LEVEL = 0.25; // amplitude, −12 dBFS
// #endregion format

// #region bars
/** Seven vertical 75 % colour bars as RGBA bytes, row by row from the top left. */
function colourBars(): Uint8Array {
  const colours: [number, number, number][] = [
    [191, 191, 191], // grey
    [191, 191, 0], // yellow
    [0, 191, 191], // cyan
    [0, 191, 0], // green
    [191, 0, 191], // magenta
    [191, 0, 0], // red
    [0, 0, 191], // blue
  ];
  const pixels = new Uint8Array(WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < HEIGHT; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < WIDTH; x++) {
      const [r, g, b] = colours[Math.floor((x * 7) / WIDTH)]!;
      const i = (y * WIDTH + x) * 4; // the first byte of pixel (x, y)
      pixels[i] = r;
      pixels[i + 1] = g;
      pixels[i + 2] = b;
      pixels[i + 3] = 255; // alpha: opaque
    }
  }
  return pixels;
}
// #endregion bars

// #region frame
const video = colourBars(); // the picture never changes: draw it once
/** Room for the longest frame: 1602 stereo samples. */
const audio = new Float32Array(2 * Math.ceil(SAMPLE_RATE / FPS));
let owed = 0; // the fraction of a sample carried over to the next frame
let phase = 0; // position in the current sine cycle, 0 ≤ phase < 1

/** The `frame` callback of openStream: one picture and its audio. */
export function frame(): StreamFrame {
  // 48000 / 29.97 = 1601.6 samples: 1601 or 1602, never drifting.
  owed += SAMPLE_RATE / FPS;
  const samples = Math.floor(owed);
  owed -= samples;

  for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
    const value = LEVEL * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * phase);
    audio[2 * i] = value; // left
    audio[2 * i + 1] = value; // right
    phase += FREQUENCY / SAMPLE_RATE;
    if (phase >= 1) phase -= 1;
  }
  return { video, audio: audio.subarray(0, 2 * samples) };
}
// #endregion frame

// #region start-stop
export default function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  let stream: Stream | undefined; // the running stream
  let starting = false;

  async function start() {
    starting = true;
    try {
      stream = await plugin.player.openStream({
        width: WIDTH,
        height: HEIGHT,
        frame, // the player calls it whenever it needs the next frame
      });
      // Another source replaced the stream, or it failed.
      stream.onStop(() => (stream = undefined));
    } finally {
      starting = false;
    }
  }

  async function stop() {
    const running = stream;
    stream = undefined;
    await running?.stop();
  }
  // #endregion start-stop

  // #region command
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "signal-generator",
    path: ["@open", "Signal generator"], // the player's Open menu, in any language
    checked: () => stream !== undefined,
    run: () => {
      if (starting) return;
      return stream ? stop() : start();
    },
  });
  // #endregion command
}
````

### examples/signal-generator/tests/signal-generator.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin, TestHost } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate, { FPS, HEIGHT, WIDTH, frame } from "../main.ts";

test("a frame is RGBA colour bars and 1601 or 1602 stereo samples", () => {
  const { video } = frame();
  assert.equal(video.length, WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4);
  assert.deepEqual([...video.subarray(0, 4)], [191, 191, 191, 255]); // grey
  const last = video.length - 4; // bottom right: blue
  assert.deepEqual([...video.subarray(last)], [0, 0, 191, 255]);

  // 300 frames are 10.01 s: the audio stays within one sample of that.
  let total = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < 300; n++) {
    const samples = frame().audio.length / 2;
    assert.ok(samples === 1601 || samples === 1602);
    total += samples;
  }
  assert.ok(Math.abs(total - (300 * 48000) / FPS) <= 1);
});

test("the sine continues smoothly from one frame to the next", () => {
  // The largest step a 1 kHz sine at amplitude 0.25 takes between samples.
  const maxStep = 0.25 * 2 * Math.PI * (1000 / 48000);
  let previous = frame().audio.at(-2)!; // the last left sample
  for (let n = 0; n < 10; n++) {
    const { audio } = frame();
    for (let i = 0; i < audio.length; i += 2) {
      assert.ok(Math.abs(audio[i]! - previous) <= maxStep + 1e-6);
      assert.equal(audio[i + 1], audio[i], "left = right");
      previous = audio[i]!;
    }
  }
});

/** Poll until `predicate()` holds: a stream starts and stops on timers. */
async function until(predicate: () => boolean) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 3000;
  while (!predicate()) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error("timed out");
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5));
  }
}

test("Open ▸ Signal generator starts the stream; choosing it again stops it", async () => {
  const host = new TestHost();
  // Windows has no Unix sockets: the frames travel over loopback TCP there.
  if (process.platform === "win32") host.producerTransport = "tcp";
  const { stop } = await startPlugin(activate, {
    directory: new URL("..", import.meta.url), // reads manifest.json
    host,
  });
  const command = () => host.command("signal-generator");
  try {
    const { declaration } = command();
    assert.deepEqual("path" in declaration && declaration.path, [
      "@open",
      "Signal generator",
    ]);

    await command().run();
    await until(() => command().state.checked === true);
    assert.equal(host.source.kind, "producer");

    await command().run();
    const producer = host.producers.get(1)!;
    await until(() => producer.released);
    assert.equal(producer.droppedWhileSelected, false, "source closed first");
    assert.equal(host.source.phase, "empty");
    assert.equal(command().state.checked, false);
  } finally {
    await stop();
  }
});
````

### examples/bookmark/README.md

````markdown
# Bookmark

A small, complete plugin: **Playback → Bookmark…** opens a tool window that remembers the current position and jumps back to it.

![Bookmark running in Vestra Player](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |

```

In the player: start it with `--plugin <path to examples/bookmark>` to run `main.ts` directly, no build needed.

````

### examples/bookmark/main.ts

````ts
import type { Plugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

/**
 * Remembers the current playback position and jumps back to it: a command,
 * a tool window, and reading and changing the playback state.
 */
// #region state
export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  const { player } = plugin;
  let mark: number | null = null;
  // #endregion state

  // #region window
  const window = plugin.windows.create("ui/bookmark.slint");
  window.bind(() => ({
    label: mark === null ? "No bookmark" : `Bookmark: ${mark.toFixed(1)} s`,
    canMark: player.state.position !== null,
    canJump: mark !== null && player.state.can.seek,
  }));
  window.on("mark", () => (mark = player.state.position));
  window.on("jump", () => player.seek(mark!));
  // #endregion window

  // #region command
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "bookmark.open",
    path: ["@playback", "Bookmark…"],
    order: 270,
    run: () => window.show(),
  });
  // #endregion command
}
````

### examples/bookmark/tests/bookmark.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin, TestHost } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate from "../main.ts";

test("mark the position, then jump back to it", async () => {
  const host = new TestHost();
  host.openElsewhere("/movie.mp4");
  host.setSource({ duration: 600, position: 42 });
  const { stop } = await startPlugin(activate, {
    directory: new URL("..", import.meta.url),
    host,
  });

  await host.command("bookmark.open").run();
  const window = host.window("bookmark");
  window.emit("mark");
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(window.props.label, "Bookmark: 42.0 s");

  host.setSource({ position: 300 }); // playback moves on
  window.emit("jump");
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(host.source.position, 42);
  await stop();
});
````

````slint
import { Button, VerticalBox, HorizontalBox } from "std-widgets.slint";
export component BookmarkWindow inherits Window {

    preferred-width: 320px;
    in property <string> label: "No bookmark";
    in property <bool> can-mark;
    in property <bool> can-jump;
    callback mark();
    callback jump();
    VerticalBox {
        Text { text: root.label; }
        HorizontalBox {
            Button { text: "Mark this position"; enabled: root.can-mark; clicked => { root.mark(); } }

        }
````

## examples/panel-menu

### examples/panel-menu/README.md

````markdown
# Panel menu

A list in the player's sidebar with its own right-click menu. Next to the player's playlist it appears as a second sidebar tab, "Example list".

![Panel menu running in Vestra Player](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |
| --- | --- |

## Run it

```sh
cd examples/panel-menu

npm run pack                # build dist/ and pack examples.panel-menu-0.1.0.vxp
```

In the player: start it with `--plugin <path to examples/panel-menu>` to run `main.ts` directly, no build needed.

Walkthrough: [Panel menu](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Panel_menu.html).
````

### examples/panel-menu/main.ts

````ts
import type { Plugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

/** A sidebar panel with its own right-click menu. */
export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  // #region state
  const items = ["First item", "Second item", "Third item"];
  let selected = 0;
  // #endregion state

  // #region mount
  const panel = plugin.panels.mount("sidebar", "ui/panel.slint", {
    title: "Example list",
  });
  panel.bind(() => ({ rows: items, selected }));
  // #endregion mount

  // #region commands
  const first = plugin.commands.add({
    id: "first",
    title: "Select the first item",
    run: () => (selected = 0),
  });
  const remove = plugin.commands.add({
    id: "remove",
    title: "Remove the selected item",
    enabled: () => items.length > 0,
    run: () => {
      items.splice(selected, 1);
      selected = Math.max(0, Math.min(selected, items.length - 1));
    },
  });
  // #endregion commands

  // #region menu
  panel.on("select", (index: number) => (selected = index));
  panel.on("contextMenu", (x: number, y: number) =>
    panel.showMenu([first, null, remove], { x, y }),
  );
  // #endregion menu
}
````

### examples/panel-menu/manifest.json

### examples/panel-menu/tests/panel-menu.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate from "../main.ts";

const directory = new URL("..", import.meta.url);

test("a right-click opens the panel's own menu", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await startPlugin(activate, { directory });
  const panel = host.mounted();
  panel.emit("select", 2); // the right button goes down on the third row…
  panel.emit("context-menu", 40, 60); // …and comes up
  await host.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(host.menus.at(-1), {
    items: ["first", null, "remove"],
    x: 40,
    y: 60,
  });
  await stop();
});

test("the menu's commands change the list", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await startPlugin(activate, { directory });
  const panel = host.mounted();
  panel.emit("select", 1);
  await host.command("remove").run();
  await host.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(panel.props.rows, ["First item", "Third item"]);
  assert.equal(panel.props.selected, 1);
  await host.command("first").run();
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(panel.props.selected, 0);
  await stop();
});
````

### examples/panel-menu/ui/panel.slint

````slint
import { Theme } from "@vestra/theme.slint";

export global ListBridge {
    in property <[string]> rows;
    in property <int> selected;
    callback select(int);
    callback context-menu(float, float);
}

export component ListPanel inherits Rectangle {
    background: Theme.bg-list;
    min-width: 200px;
    VerticalLayout {
        for row[index] in ListBridge.rows: Rectangle {
            height: 20px;
            background: index == ListBridge.selected ? Theme.selected-bg : transparent;
            Text {
                x: 6px;
                text: (index + 1) + ". " + row;
                color: index == ListBridge.selected ? Theme.text : Theme.text-list;
                font-size: Theme.font-body;
                vertical-alignment: center;
            }
            TouchArea {
                pointer-event(event) => {
                    if event.kind == PointerEventKind.down {
                        ListBridge.select(index);
                    }
                    if event.kind == PointerEventKind.up && event.button == PointerEventButton.right {
                        ListBridge.context-menu((self.absolute-position.x + self.mouse-x) / 1px,
                            (self.absolute-position.y + self.mouse-y) / 1px);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Takes the space below the rows. Without it the layout's maximum
        // height (three 20px rows) would cap the player's main window.
        Rectangle { vertical-stretch: 1; }
    }
}
````

## examples/menus

### examples/menus/README.md

````markdown
# Menus

An **Examples** menu with the speeds 0.5×, 1×, 1.5× and 2× as radio items, and below a separator a **Speed: 1×** item whose title changes when you pick a speed.

![Menus running in Vestra Player](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |
| --- | --- |
| `commands`, `playback.read`, `events`, `playback.control` | `commands.add` (`radio`, `checked`, `group`, `order`, `enabled`), `scope()`, `player.setRate` |

## Run it

```sh
cd examples/menus
npm install
npm run check && npm test   # type check, then the tests against the in-memory test host
npm run pack                # build dist/ and pack examples.menus-0.1.0.vxp
```

In the player: start it with `--plugin <path to examples/menus>` to run `main.ts` directly, no build needed.

Walkthrough: [Menus](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Menus.html).
````

### examples/menus/main.ts

````ts
// #region setup
import type { Plugin, Scope } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

/** Menu items: radio items, separator groups and a title that changes. */
export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  const { player } = plugin;
  // #endregion setup

  // #region title
  let status: Scope = plugin.scope();
  async function showSpeed(rate: number) {
    await status.dispose(); // removes the previous item from the menu
    status = plugin.scope();
    status.commands.add({
      id: "speed",
      path: ["Examples", `Speed: ${rate}×`],
      order: 860,
      group: "status",
      enabled: false,
      run() {},
    });
  }
  await showSpeed(player.state.rate);
  // #endregion title

  // #region radio
  for (const [index, rate] of [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2].entries())
    plugin.commands.add({
      id: `rate-${rate}`,
      path: ["Examples", `${rate}×`],
      order: 850 + index,
      group: "speeds",
      radio: true,
      checked: () => player.state.rate === rate,
      enabled: () => player.state.can.rate,
      run: async () => {
        await player.setRate(rate);
        await showSpeed(rate);
      },
    });
  // #endregion radio
}
````

### examples/menus/tests/menus.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin, TestHost } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate from "../main.ts";

const directory = new URL("..", import.meta.url);

test("the speeds are radio items in their own group", async () => {
  const host = new TestHost();
  host.openElsewhere("/movie.mp4"); // a file is open, so the speed can change
  const { stop } = await startPlugin(activate, { directory, host });
  const half = host.command("rate-0.5").declaration;
  assert.ok("radio" in half && half.radio);
  assert.equal(half.group, "speeds");
  assert.equal(host.command("rate-1").state.checked, true);

  await host.command("rate-2").run();
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(host.command("rate-2").state.checked, true);
  assert.equal(host.command("rate-1").state.checked, false);
  await stop();
});

test("the status item is added again with a new title", async () => {
  const host = new TestHost();
  host.openElsewhere("/movie.mp4");
  const { stop } = await startPlugin(activate, { directory, host });
  assert.deepEqual(host.command("speed").declaration.path, [
    "Examples",
    "Speed: 1×",
  ]);
  await host.command("rate-1.5").run();
  await host.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(host.command("speed").declaration.path, [
    "Examples",
    "Speed: 1.5×",
  ]);
  await stop();
});
````

## examples/theme-widgets

### examples/theme-widgets/README.md

````markdown
# Theme widgets

**Examples → Theme widgets…** opens a tool window drawn with the player's own theme and widgets (`@vestra/theme.slint`, `@vestra/widgets.slint`): two sliders, a small button, icon buttons and tooltips.

![Theme widgets running in Vestra Player](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |
| --- | --- |
| `commands`, `ui.window` | `windows.create`, `Window.bind` / `on`; `Theme`, `Button`, `Slider`, `ToolTipArea` in Slint |

## Run it

```sh
cd examples/theme-widgets
npm install
npm run check && npm test   # type check, then the tests against the in-memory test host
npm run pack                # build dist/ and pack examples.theme-widgets-0.1.0.vxp
```

In the player: start it with `--plugin <path to examples/theme-widgets>` to run `main.ts` directly, no build needed.

Walkthrough: [Theme widgets](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Theme_widgets.html).
````

### examples/theme-widgets/main.ts

````ts
import type { Plugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

/** A tool window drawn with the player's own theme and widgets. */
export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  // #region window
  let level = 0.5;
  const window = plugin.windows.create("ui/theme-widgets.slint");
  window.bind(() => ({ level, label: `Level ${Math.round(level * 100)}` }));
  window.on("levelChanged", (value: number) => (level = value));
  window.on("reset", () => (level = 0.5));
  // #endregion window

  // #region command
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "open",
    path: ["Examples", "Theme widgets…"],
    run: () => window.show(),
  });
  // #endregion command
}
````

### examples/theme-widgets/tests/theme-widgets.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate from "../main.ts";

test("the sliders report the level; Default resets it", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await startPlugin(activate, {
    directory: new URL("..", import.meta.url),
  });
  await host.command("open").run();
  const window = host.window("theme-widgets");
  assert.equal(window.props.label, "Level 50");

  window.emit("level-changed", 0.8); // the user drags a slider
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(window.props.label, "Level 80");

  window.emit("reset"); // the user presses Default
  await host.settle();
  assert.equal(window.props.level, 0.5);
  assert.equal(window.props.label, "Level 50");
  await stop();
});
````

### examples/theme-widgets/ui/theme-widgets.slint

````slint
import { Theme } from "@vestra/theme.slint";
import { Button, Slider, ToolTipArea } from "@vestra/widgets.slint";

export component ThemeWidgets inherits Window {
    title: "Theme widgets";
    width: 301px;
    background: Theme.bg-panel;
    in-out property <float> level;
    in property <string> label;
    callback level-changed(float);
    callback reset();
    VerticalLayout {
        padding: Theme.dialog-padding;
        spacing: 12px;
        HorizontalLayout {
            spacing: 8px;
            ToolTipArea {
                text: "Drag a slider, or press Default";
                width: 65px;
                Text { text: root.label; color: Theme.text; font-size: Theme.font-body; horizontal-alignment: right; vertical-alignment: center; }
            }
            Slider { panel: true; value <=> root.level; changed(value) => { root.level-changed(value); } }
            Button { text: "Default"; small: true; clicked => { root.reset(); } }
        }
        Slider { value <=> root.level; changed(value) => { root.level-changed(value); } }
        HorizontalLayout {
            alignment: end;
            spacing: 8px;
            ToolTipArea {
                text: "Reset";
                Button { width: 25px; icon: "M 3 2.5 L 11 10.5 M 11 2.5 L 3 10.5"; stroked: true; clicked => { root.reset(); } }
            }
            Button { width: 25px; icon: "M 0 0 L 12 6 L 0 12 Z"; icon-width: 12px; checked: root.level > 0.5; }
        }
    }
}
````

## examples/markdown

### examples/markdown/README.md

````markdown
# Markdown

**Examples → Markdown example…** opens a window that shows `sample.md` with the player's `MarkdownView` component: headings, lists, code, quotes, a table and an image from the package. The manifest also has the display fields the plugin manager shows (`name`, `author`, `punchline`, `description`, `tags`, `icon`, `license`).

![Markdown running in Vestra Player](screenshot.png)

| Capabilities | API |
| --- | --- |
| `commands`, `ui.window` | `ui.markdown`, `MarkdownView` from `@vestra/markdown.slint`, `Window.set`; package assets in `package.json` (`"vestra": { "assets": [...] }`) |

## Run it

```sh
cd examples/markdown
npm install
npm run check && npm test   # type check, then the tests against the in-memory test host
npm run pack                # build dist/ and pack examples.markdown-0.1.0.vxp
```

In the player: start it with `--plugin <path to examples/markdown>` to run `main.ts` directly, no build needed.

Walkthrough: [Markdown](https://vestrasys.github.io/vestra-player-sdk/documents/Example__Markdown.html).
````

### examples/markdown/main.ts

````ts
// #region imports
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import type { Plugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk";
// #endregion imports

/** A tool window that shows a Markdown document. */
export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  // #region document
  const directory = fileURLToPath(new URL(".", import.meta.url));
  const window = plugin.windows.create("ui/document.slint");
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "show",
    path: ["Examples", "Markdown example…"],
    run: async () => {
      const text = readFileSync(new URL("sample.md", import.meta.url), "utf8");
      window.set({ doc: await plugin.ui.markdown(text, { base: directory }) });
      await window.show();
    },
  });
  // #endregion document
}
````

### examples/markdown/sample.md

````markdown
# Markdown example

This window shows the **core Markdown component**: *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~ and `inline code`.

## Lists

- A bulleted list
- A second item, with **bold** text
  1. A nested numbered list
  2. Its second item
- [x] A finished task
- [ ] An open task

## Code and quotes

```ts
const doc = await plugin.ui.markdown(text, { base });
window.set({ doc });
```

> The player parses and draws the Markdown; the plugin only passes the text.

## Tables

| Element | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Headings, paragraphs, lists | Yes |
| Code blocks, quotes, tables | Yes |
| Inline HTML | No (not shown) |

## Images

A local image, `assets/icon.png` in the package, found through `base`:

![Icon](assets/icon.png)
````

### examples/markdown/tests/markdown.test.ts

````ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import test from "node:test";
import { startPlugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk/testing";
import activate from "../main.ts";

const directory = new URL("..", import.meta.url);

test("the window shows sample.md, with the package as its base", async () => {
  const { host, stop } = await startPlugin(activate, { directory });
  await host.command("show").run();
  await host.settle();
  const window = host.window("document");
  assert.equal(window.visible, true);
  const doc = host.markdown(window.props.doc);
  assert.ok(doc);
  assert.match(doc.text, /^# Markdown example/);
  assert.equal(doc.base, fileURLToPath(directory));
  await stop();
});
````

### examples/markdown/ui/document.slint

````slint
import { MarkdownView, MarkdownBlock } from "@vestra/markdown.slint";
import { Theme } from "@vestra/theme.slint";

export component Document inherits Window {
    title: "Markdown example";
    preferred-width: 520px;
    preferred-height: 560px;
    min-width: 280px;
    min-height: 200px;
    background: Theme.bg-panel;
    in property <[MarkdownBlock]> doc;
    MarkdownView {
        blocks: root.doc;
    }
}
````
